filter_messages_with_MessageFiltering: create a MessageFiltering instance and call filter_messages to remove offensive, repetitive, or nonsensical messages from a list
edit_messages_with_MessageEditing: create a MessageEditing instance and call edit_messages to fix corrupted newlines, redact names, and fix weird capitalization
should_filter_message_check: call should_filter_message on a MessageFiltering instance to check if a single message should be filtered based on configured criteria
filter_grounding_keywords: use _should_filter_grounding to detect and filter messages containing out-of-character keywords like real-world dates, times, or platform references
filter_insults_and_rude_language: use _should_filter_insults to detect and filter messages containing insulting or rude language based on substring and regex patterns
